items.question: In which TSG RAN CR pack was change request R3-237507 (CR 1108 to TS 38.423) submitted? Give the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting. Decide from the records in this order. First, if a CR pack record lists this change request, give one row for each such CR pack. Otherwise, if a RAN3 meeting report records a decision on the whole document that closed it without approval (withdrawn, not treated, not pursued, rejected or not agreed), the change request was not submitted to TSG RAN: answer with no rows. Otherwise the records do not determine the CR pack: answer with exactly one row that has INSUFFICIENT_RECORDS in both fields, not with an empty answer.
